parsed.rationale: I don't see anterior MI: there are no pathologic Q waves and R-wave progression is preserved. V2-V3 have very deep S waves (about 25-30 mm) and V4-V5 have tall R waves (about 30 mm), so the voltage meets LVH criteria (S in V3 plus R in V5 well above 35 mm). The concave ST elevation in V2-V3 is proportionate to the deep S waves, which is the usual LVH repolarization pattern and does not meet STEMI criteria.
